title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail

The Opportunity
Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car - not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.
The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard - agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens - web, desktop, our own browser, mobile - so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.
This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record - across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.
A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field - no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit - full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.
